tasks.label: Cashio: Metro pentru telefon USB
tasks.command: fnm env --shell powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression; fnm use 22; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; npx.cmd expo start --dev-client --host lan --port 8082

tasks.label: Cashio: reparare development build USB
tasks.command: fnm env --shell powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression; fnm use 22; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $env:JAVA_HOME='C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr'; $env:ANDROID_HOME=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Android\Sdk'; $env:ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=$env:ANDROID_HOME; $env:ANDROID_SDK_HOME=$null; .\android\gradlew.bat -p android app:assembleDebug -PreactNativeArchitectures=arm64-v8a; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & "$env:ANDROID_HOME\platform-tools\adb.exe" -d install -r .\android\app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk
